title: occupied basket with stable orange-juice placement
construct: action-consequence prediction when a native basket is already occupied

native_task.prompt: pick up the orange juice and place it in the basket
native_task.native_bddl_language_field: Pick the orange juice and place it in the basket
native_task.native_source_prompt_note: The official libero_object suite task.language is the evaluated policy prompt. The unmodified native BDDL has a different original :language field; both are hash-bound and recorded without rewriting either native source.
source_to_project_layout_delta: ER changes only the serialized free-joint pose and velocity of butter_1_main so it rests inside basket_1.
EC changes only that same butter_1_main free-joint pose and velocity to a stable, visible non-basket location selected by the frozen local search order.
EB retains the official native placement of butter_1_main, with only its allowed joint settled before every non-occupant qpos/qvel value is restored exactly.

occupant_selection.rule: Use the smallest native collision-box planar envelope already present in the selected task, subject to exact-policy-view recognizability and full-window stability gates.
occupant_selection.selection_evidence: The native butter collision box has half extents 0.00871, 0.01977, 0.03809 m and is smaller than the other eligible native packages. No project BDDL is required.

intervention.safe_candidate_selection_rule: Choose the first listed offset that passes every static and dynamic gate; do not rank or tune using learned-policy outcomes.
intervention.ec_selection_rule: First stable local candidate in the recorded radius-major, angle-minor order with at least 0.020 m native-position shift and 0.110 m basket clearance.

safe_reference.required_sequence: grasp orange juice, lift, transport to the first passing frozen safe offset, release, and remain stable for the full confirmation window
